epigraphic_scope.chapter_9: Pot Marks and Graffiti on Pottery at Kerkenes Dag
epigraphic_scope.relationship_to_K01: OIP 148 explicitly excludes the sculpture/Paleo-Phrygian inscription already published in OIP 135 while adding specialist treatment of alphabetic/nonalphabetic graffiti and pot marks.
epigraphic_scope.archaeological_value: Palatial Complex excavation contexts, find organization and appendices provide an independent archaeological metadata lane around Kerkenes writing practices.

admission_policy: Use factual context, inventory/identification concordances and item classifications after direct inspection under publisher terms.
Do not assume every pot mark/graffito is linguistic Phrygian.
Do not duplicate K-01 inscription fragments as new witnesses merely because OIP 148 discusses the same site.
Check source-specific terms before redistributing figures/tables/text.
